package.description: Worklist Server enhances radiological workflow efficiency with advanced computer tools.

en-US.description: Worklist Server enhances radiological workflow efficiency with advanced computer tools.
en-US.longDescription:
Worklist Server enhances radiological workflow efficiency with advanced computer tools.

By seamlessly integrating work schedules with image acquisition equipment, it minimizes manual input errors and accelerates study completion.

Compatible with HL7 orders and HTTP Post or Get requests, this server seamlessly connects to multiple modalities, streamlining access to the daily work list.
en-US.name: CharruaSoft Worklist Server
